shorts.name: Clip counter
shorts.job: Persistent top tracker for a compilation: which clip you're on ('3 / 10') with a segmented progress bar that advances on each cut. Keeps viewers watching to the end.

shorts.name: Rank badge
shorts.job: Top-N ranking moment: a big '#3' numeral with the item's title lands, then docks into a small corner badge that stays while the clip plays.

shorts.name: Hook title
shorts.job: The opening hook in the top third of the frame ('GTA 6 details nobody noticed'), one keyword accented.

shorts.name: Word captions
shorts.job: Spoken-word captions for voiceover compilations: 1–3 words at a time, the active word in the sunset accent, inside the caption safe zone.

shorts.name: GTA 5 vs GTA 6 split
shorts.job: A 9:16-native stacked comparison: GTA V clip on top, GTA VI below, era chips with year, a clean divider. Uses plates g01/g02 (GTA V) and a GTA VI plate.

shorts.name: Blurred fill frame
shorts.job: A 16:9 clip framed in 9:16: the clip centred as a rounded card over a blurred, darkened, enlarged copy of itself, a title above and a source/handle line below.

shorts.name: Release countdown
shorts.job: Countdown to the release on November 19, 2026: days, hours, minutes rolling, with the platforms line.

shorts.name: Wanted level
shorts.job: Wanted stars that fill one by one (1→5) as a clip escalates. Sparse and thin like Rockstar's real GTA VI HUD (our own star drawing).

shorts.name: Wasted stamp
shorts.job: The fail sting: footage desaturates and slows, a dark band slides in and the word lands. Our own type (no Pricedown).

shorts.name: Mission passed
shorts.job: The win sting: 'MISSION PASSED' lands with a sub-line and a rolling cash reward; the clean counterpart to the fail stamp.

shorts.name: News chyron
shorts.job: In-world style breaking-news lower third with a LIVE tag and a ticker, for leak/news segments. Our own fictional network name, not Weazel.

shorts.name: Location card
shorts.job: Location reveal for a new area of Leonida: name, region, small coordinates.

shorts.name: Source tag
shorts.job: Small credit tag for each clip: 'Footage: Rockstar Games · Trailer 2' or the creator's @handle, sits in a safe corner.

shorts.name: Circle callout
shorts.job: Points out a detail: a clean ring draws around it, a leader line runs to a label pill ('Real-time reflections').

shorts.name: Magnifier zoom
shorts.job: A lens that pulls a 2.5× zoom of one region of the footage into an inset, joined to the spot by a leader, with a label.

shorts.name: Arrow pointer
shorts.job: A clean drawn arrow that points at something in frame with a short label ('Look at the water').

shorts.name: Freeze-frame detail
shorts.job: The clip freezes, the surround dims and desaturates, a spotlight isolates the detail and a label explains it, then playback resumes.

shorts.name: Slow-mo replay
shorts.job: Replay moment: 'REPLAY 0.25×' badge, a scrub bar with playhead, footage slows down.

shorts.name: Name tag
shorts.job: Identifies a character on screen: 'JASON DUVAL · Protagonist' attached by a leader line, or as a lower third.

shorts.name: Spec card
shorts.job: A spec block for a vehicle or era in an evolution/detail compilation: name plus 3 stats with bars.

shorts.name: Before/after slider
shorts.job: A slider wipes between GTA V and GTA VI footage of a similar shot, with era labels on each side.

shorts.name: Evolution timeline
shorts.job: GTA evolution by year: GTA III 2001 → Vice City 2002 → San Andreas 2004 → GTA IV 2008 → GTA V 2013 → GTA VI 2026, advancing card by card.

shorts.name: Tier list
shorts.job: S/A/B/C tier list: items drop into tiers one by one (e.g. GTA games ranked). Ends with 'Comment yours'.

shorts.name: Versus card
shorts.job: A head-to-head title: 'JASON vs LUCIA' or 'GTA V vs GTA VI'.

shorts.name: Trailer views race
shorts.job: Bars race to real numbers: Trailer 1 305.4M, Trailer 2 189.6M, Launch Trailer 82.0M YouTube views.

shorts.name: Stat count-up
shorts.job: A huge number rolls up to a real stat (305,372,086 views on Trailer 1) with its label; or a record badge (90M+ views in 24 hours).

shorts.name: Top 3 podium
shorts.job: Three.js podium for a top-3 reveal: third, second, first rise with labels, camera settles on the winner.

shorts.name: Clip carousel
shorts.job: Three.js ring of 5 clip cards (top-5 intro) that rotates and lands on the next item, the chosen card plays.

shorts.name: This or that
shorts.job: A this-or-that poll card ('Jason or Lucia?') with a tap and fill animation, ending on 'Comment A or B'.

shorts.name: Facecam split
shorts.job: Reaction layout: facecam (assets/plates/facecam-sample.mp4, a stand-in talking head) plus gameplay, with a clean seam and label.

shorts.name: Clip grid
shorts.job: Several clips at once with numbered labels ('4 details in 4 seconds').

shorts.name: Cinematic bars
shorts.job: Letterbox bars slide in with a place/time stamp, or a CCTV-style stamp, for cinematic or 'caught on camera' moments.

shorts.name: Social video frame
shorts.job: A clip presented as an in-world social video post: avatar, fictional handle, Follow pill, caption, like count.

shorts.name: Time skip card
shorts.job: '3 HOURS LATER' or a date card between scenes.

shorts.name: Sunset wipe
shorts.job: Transition between two clips: diagonal bands in the Leonida sunset gradient sweep across.

shorts.name: Punch zoom transition
shorts.job: Fast punch-in zoom blur (or whip pan) from one clip into the next, with a light flash.

shorts.name: Chapter card
shorts.job: Interstitial between segments: 'DETAIL 04' + title, over a sunset card or the blurred footage.

shorts.name: X post card
shorts.job: An X post card (by @everestchris6) with one phrase highlighted and counts rolling.

shorts.name: Headline card
shorts.job: A news headline card with one phrase highlighted, using real reported headlines (publication-neutral).

shorts.name: Rumor stamp
shorts.job: Marks a claim as UNCONFIRMED (rumor/leak) or CONFIRMED (official), with a source chip.

shorts.name: Comment reply
shorts.job: Reply-to-comment sticker ('Reply to @user: is the water real?') that opens a video answering it.

shorts.name: Pre-load progress
shorts.job: Diegetic hook: a download bar for 'Grand Theft Auto VI' ticking 98% → 100% → 'Ready to play'. Our own neutral UI, no console or store branding.

shorts.name: Phone message
shorts.job: In-game style phone: a text from Lucia slides in as a notification or a short thread.

shorts.name: Minimap route
shorts.job: A rounded translucent minimap (abstract roads) where a GPS route draws to the destination blip.

shorts.name: Mission objective
shorts.job: Mission objective text ('Go to the Vice City Marina.') with the keyword accented; or a mission title card.

shorts.name: Cash payout
shorts.job: Money rolls up (+$1,250,000) for heist/payout moments.

shorts.name: Race HUD
shorts.job: Racing overlay in Rockstar's sparse style: LAP 1/2, position 3/8, a ticking timer; or a speedometer.

shorts.name: Character intro
shorts.job: Freeze-frame character intro: 'LUCIA CAMINOS' with a role line; or a character switch wheel.

shorts.name: Follow CTA
shorts.job: End-of-short CTA: 'Follow for Part 2' with a follow button press, or a next-part card.

shorts.name: End card
shorts.job: Closing card in Rockstar's end-tile language: ink-navy tile, wide-tracked date line, channel name.
